title: Sonic behind waterfall - RetroArch shader comparison
summary: A one-minute demo comparing RetroArch shaders on the Sonic the Hedgehog waterfall, where Sega Genesis dithering creates a transparency effect. It shows how different shaders emulate the CRT look.
why: HN cites it as the example showing why CRT emulation is needed to render effects the original artists intended.

quote.text: here's a video that shows the Sonic waterfall in motion with various CRT-simulating shaders applied on top
